rules.why: Coverage turns on certificate-of-occupancy date and rent-stabilization status, and the 2026 date is when the Measure BB changes take effect.
Just-cause coverage follows fully or partially covered Berkeley Rent Ordinance units, while the stated date is for approved relocation-payment increases.
The rule applies only to units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, and no effective date is given.
It applies broadly to Berkeley residential rental applications or tenancy fee situations without building-age or program limits, and no effective date is given.
It broadly covers Berkeley rental housing providers, with only special exemptions such as owner-occupied small properties and public or subsidized housing, and no effective date is given.
It applies citywide to residential dwelling units without building-specific coverage limits, and January 2026 is stated as the chapter's effective date.
